candidate.title: ORGANIC
candidate.scope: The single ORGANIC row of the assigned Illumina schematic: Occupied regions of genomes from affinity-purified naturally isolated chromatin. It depicts native chromatin preparation from cells, MNase digestion, soluble recovery, and a combined immunoprecipitation/DNA-extraction endpoint. The chromatin vignette at the left explains the target; it is not an upstream preparation operation. Adjacent X-ChIP, ATAC-Seq and the clipped PAT-ChIP row are separate poster rows, not alternatives within this card. The graph ends at extracted DNA; subsequent sequencing-library construction is an interpretive interface supported by the cited paper, without adding unshown library-preparation operations. No pooled, split or alternative branch is depicted for ORGANIC. The verified secondary catalogue page lists additional ORGANIC references and supporting review/bias citations; only their catalogue entries are available here, so they do not establish additional target methods or primary protocol content.

operations.label: MNase digestion

operations.information_effect: Converts protein occupancy and protection into DNA fragment boundaries and lengths, subject to digestion susceptibility and MNase sequence bias.

operations.label: Immunoprecipitate and DNA extraction
operations.description: Affinity-select chromatin carrying the protein of interest from the soluble extract and recover DNA from the selected complexes. The combined source block is retained as one operation.
operations.mechanism: Antibody-mediated immunoprecipitation enriches target-associated chromatin; removal of protein and DNA extraction yield the DNA carrier.
operations.information_effect: Replaces the physical protein–DNA complex with DNA fragments whose origin records enrichment for the selected protein association. Subsequent sequencing can map the recovered genomic regions and, in the cited paired-end implementation, protected fragment lengths. Recovery depends on native association stability, digestion, solubilization and affinity selection; enrichment alone does not establish enzymatic activity or complete in vivo occupancy.

method_scopes.rationale: All four local operations belong to the ORGANIC row. Nuclear isolation and MNase digestion act on native chromatin; soluble recovery feeds the row's combined affinity-selection/DNA-extraction block. The matching collection page explicitly identifies the same route as ORGANIC and states that it avoids crosslinking and sonication. The poster-cited paper supports this architecture through its uncrosslinked yeast remodeler N-ChIP-seq implementation; its separate X-ChIP comparison and input controls are not added to this row. This resolves the schematic implementation, without claiming all native-ChIP implementations are interchangeable.
